looks.label: Palette shader
looks.technique: one fragment body for colour, partial hue, text, land and spectral modes; red channel of the sprite is a 32-entry palette index; partial hue recolours only pure-grey pixels; spectral and shadow modes are a grey ramp at 1.5x, 0.5x or fixed 0.6

looks.label: See-through circle around the player
looks.technique: circle sprite with alpha falling off linearly with radius (cap 200); draw pass writes alpha only and sets a stencil marker; compositing pass not read

looks.label: Bearing pointer
looks.technique: screen-space arrow with eight directional frames chosen from the bearing to the goal; iso projection with a step of 22 units; clamped to the window edges; colorizer flash for about 120 ms, re-armed one second ahead

looks.label: Gusting weather layer
looks.technique: particle count from window area divided by 7500 plus a base; size ratio per particle from its id; wind re-rolled every 7-13 s; sign cannot flip directly (passes through zero)

looks.label: Colorizer flash as a HUD cue
looks.technique: a recolour pass used as a short periodic flash on a HUD element, not on the world

originals.name: Halo Sight
originals.idea: a see-through halo at the hero so occluders fade near the hero
originals.keep: radial alpha falloff, radius cap, alpha-only write
originals.change: elliptical iso falloff, our fade time, a mobile-width radius

originals.name: Bearing Pin
originals.idea: a HUD pointer to the next objective with eight bearing frames
originals.keep: eight bearing frames, clamped to the HUD edge, a short colour flash on a one-second rhythm
originals.change: our ribbon shape, palette, a flash rule that never blocks input

originals.name: Palette Dye
originals.idea: one shader that maps the red channel to a 32-entry palette with grey-only hue and a spectral ramp

originals.name: Gust Layer
originals.idea: zone weather with area-scaled particles and a wind re-roll that cannot flip sign
originals.keep: particle count from area, random size per particle, wind timer 7-13 s, passes through zero

originals.name: Bulletin Pin
originals.idea: a notice-board window of posted notes
